title: Nubank: David vs Goliaths - [Business Breakdowns, EP.123]

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: This is Zack Fuss, an investor at Irenic Capital, and today we’re breaking down Nubank.
reader_summary.overview: This is Zack Fuss, an investor at Irenic Capital, and today we’re breaking down Nubank. The Brazilian-based neobank has gone from nothing to extraordinary scale in a short period of time. 10 years after its founding, the company counts 46% of Brazil’s adult population as customers, is the largest Fintech in Latin America.

key_points.text: 10 years after its founding, the company counts 46% of Brazil’s adult population as customers, is the largest Fintech in Latin America.
The fact that it’s achieved this in an environment that heavily favored the large incumbent banks makes its story all the more impressive.
To break down the business, I am joined by Daniel Bakalarz, Managing Partner at Unison Asset Management.
